task: Six common shot families with automatic classification or human review
taxonomy_note: Common coaching families, not an empirically verified worldwide frequency ranking. Drive combines cover and straight drives; six output families are not six native archive labels.
data: CricShot10k author archives, all 15 native categories; audit actual files and cross-category duplicates.
split_rule: Preserve previous train/test source separation. Split validation components deterministically into disjoint tune, calibration and policy roles. Exclude newly connected components that bridge old train/validation/test partitions. New source components enter test. Unseen-style classes never enter training, tuning, calibration or policy selection.
test_history: Existing test source groups were evaluated in the eight-class study. The new six-class test is a reused benchmark, not a wholly new independent benchmark. No current-run test scores will select models/calibration/policy.
linear: Train-only standardisation; raw video-mean baseline, other descriptors use train-only whitened PCA128; balanced multinomial logistic regression.
model_selection: Tune macro F1; evaluate recorded linear candidates, two-seed neural ensembles and matched full/motion ensembles. No tune-plus-train refit.
scope_head: Binary balanced logistic regression on train-only PCA128 context features; known six families versus the five exposure categories. Select C using tune AUROC.
calibration: Fit one temperature for the six-class conditional distribution and a Platt sigmoid for scope logits using calibration groups only.
support: Joint support_i = calibrated in-scope score times calibrated conditional class score_i. Scores sum to the in-scope score, not necessarily one.
review_rule: Exactly one support score strictly above the selected common threshold -> automatic label; zero or multiple -> human review. No forced top-1 fallback.
policy_selection: On policy groups only: maximise known coverage among thresholds meeting 90% known automatic accuracy and 85% exposure review. Report whether the 75% known-coverage goal is met. If no threshold meets the accuracy/rejection targets, choose the greatest balanced objective (known coverage * known automatic accuracy - unknown false-automatic rate); explicitly report the target failure.
uncertainty: 2,000 source-component bootstrap draws, seed604, fixed models and policy; no independent-match or universal unknown-detection guarantee.
external_clip: User Kohli clip is a previously seen qualitative diagnostic only. No threshold, training label or model choice is fit to that clip.
novelty: Course-level integration of focused/global temporal context, calibrated scope support, explicit candidate-set review and measured risk/coverage; established component methods attributed.
